questions.question: What observation would distinguish observer-relative experience from universal personal identity?
questions.baseline: Distinct observers with shared world vs open-individualist interpretation
questions.discriminator: Require an identity criterion and a contrast that would differ; otherwise NO_EMPIRICAL_DISCRIMINATOR_KNOWN
questions.wake: New defensible identity condition or independent critique

questions.question: When does question-led inquiry beat a strong direct answer?
questions.baseline: Strong answer-first with sources; question-led evidence-and-test flow
questions.discriminator: Blind compare accuracy, latency, human effort, confusion and voluntary return over bounded tasks; allow the answer-first baseline to win

questions.question: When does stochastic variation improve information gain rather than reinforce noise?
questions.baseline: Diversity-preserving selected alternatives vs reproducibly seeded random vs no-change
questions.discriminator: Equal-budget preregistered question yield, false positives, downstream test quality and opportunity cost
questions.wake: Repeat on changed datasets and independent reviews

questions.question: Which simpler forecasting baseline wins under distribution shift?
questions.baseline: Last-observation vs moving average vs richer history model
questions.discriminator: Prequential prospective errors on held-out data, report regime-change and missingness effects; avoid retrospective fitting

questions.question: What invariants survive a local-to-global-to-local translation?
questions.baseline: Direct local description vs aggregated global graph vs reverse-projected local view
questions.discriminator: Track scope, source and uncertainty; count information loss and reversibility failures

questions.question: Which unexpressed needs merit exploration without inventing consent?
questions.baseline: Explicit demand-only vs alternative supply/demand/G_dSide ranking
questions.discriminator: Declare who is affected, rights, alternatives, permission and negative effects before optionality claims

questions.question: What should remain unanswered, dormant or retired?
questions.baseline: Always-questioning vs no-change with explicit wake vs bounded challenge pass
questions.discriminator: Count cost, duplication, orphaned work, evidence yield and real receiver benefit; stop on no discriminating next test
questions.wake: New evidence, contradiction, changed receiver need

questions.question: Does a question-oriented public entrance help someone without CoAll vocabulary?
questions.baseline: Direct answer/FAQ vs question garden with answer, counterpoint and path
questions.discriminator: Compare first-task completion, time-to-usefulness, understanding, opt-out burden and retention without engagement optimization
